payload.core_mechanism_summary: Use property: M XOR (M+1) gives all-ones number. Check if N is all-ones via N & (N+1) == 0, then M = N//2 (except N=1 -> M=2).
payload.rationale: The solution exploits the fact that XOR of consecutive integers yields a bitmask of ones. It checks N's form using bitwise AND, fitting bit manipulation and specifically the XOR trick subtype.
